process_gate: Every project must establish this invariant/engineering-budget gate before broad implementation. Downstream packages reference invariant IDs and cannot become READY when required invariants are absent. Prototype-only empirical behavior is explicitly marked REQUIRES PROTOTYPE VALIDATION and is not fabricated as a pre-fabrication PASS.
